novelty_flags.label: Theorem 4B / def:ztt-basis-approximation
novelty_flags.one_line: The proposal calls the Zhou--Tchetgen Tchetgen S8.2 approximation a fixed outcome-basis module \(\gamma_0(X)+\sum_r\gamma_r(X)p_r(Y)\), but S8.2 uses outcome partitions and nuisance-dependent \(p_t^K(Y,X)\), so the claimed embedding is not the cited construction.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: Theorem 8 and Open-ended Question 2
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Efficient estimation and inference are conditional on the displayed coherent-nuisance product-rate conditions; their attainable spline first stage is explicitly unresolved.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The efficient CLT and variance-consistency claim is only UNDER \(R_\Sigma=o_P(1)\) and \(\Delta_n=o_P(n^{-1/2})\), with attainability delegated to Open-ended Question 2.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives the binary observed tangent/orthocomplement characterization, states that continuous-outcome closed-form EIFs are not generally available, and approximates with partition-based, conditional-probability-dependent functions \(p_t^K(Y,X)\).
The categorical-action extension defines inverse-feature representations \(q_a^X\), proves their conditional indicator property, and constructs product representations and a valid influence function.

source_verification_receipts.version: public arXiv v2; cited v3 was not publicly inspectable
source_verification_receipts.locator: Sections 2-3, lines 218-259 in arXiv HTML rendering
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper compares bridge and array-decomposition restrictions, describes Deaner's full-law recovery route, and notes application of array decomposition to hidden-treatment models.
Under stated proxy restrictions, the paper identifies latent conditional laws up to reordering and then counterfactual laws; it does not state a uniformly bounded DQM inverse.
The paper identifies a broad class of continuous nonclassical measurement-error models through an eigenvalue-eigenfunction decomposition under a location/indexing condition.

source_verification_receipts.version: preprint corresponding to Annals of Statistics 37(6A), 2009
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper establishes latent-structure identifiability using Kruskal-type arguments for conditionally independent observed variables.
The paper develops locally efficient semiparametric estimators for functional measurement-error models and states efficiency when computed under the truth.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the arbitrary \(\mathcal H_s^{\mathrm{ZTT}}\) embedding with the actual S8.2 partition sequence \(P_1^K\), its conditional-probability-dependent basis \(p_t^K(Y,X)\), and a precisely proved inclusion/projection comparison before asserting the variance frontier.

Make the multilevel result a strict scope theorem against the binary comparator: state the exact \(K\geq3\) class, the binary restriction it contains, and an explicit non-binary law on which the new finite operator is evaluable and nonzero.
Promote the DQM-lifting question into the stated central gate by isolating a constant-\(X\) finite-feature subcase with an explicit derivative inverse and then extending it to conditional \(X\).
